description: Draw a classic gradient on the active layer, inside the selection if there is one, from one point to another (Gradient tool in Classic gradient mode): linear, radial, angle, reflected or diamond, with colour and opacity stops, reverse, dither, transparency and interpolation. Without colours it runs from the foreground to the background colour

colors.description: Colour stops. Default foreground to background

midpoint.description: Percent between this stop and the next. Default 50

dither.description: Dither to reduce banding. Default true

from.description: Start point, pixels from the top-left

interpolation.description: How colours blend between stops. Default perceptual

opacities.description: Opacity stops. Default fully opaque throughout

reverse.description: Reverse the colour order. Default false

to.description: End point, pixels from the top-left

transparency.description: Use the opacity stops (the Transparency option). Default true

name: draw_gradient
title: Draw Gradient
